messages:
mai: quick check on API Keys empty state + create modal copy. Users get stuck after creating because the 'copy' is toast-only.
harry: agree. propose persistent inline 'key preview' card after create (only visible once) with a clear 'Copy' btn and an expiry pill.
sam: implement-wise: show preview card in list with role=region and aria-live polite when it appears. copy should trigger 'Copied!' aria-live update.
nora: accessibility: the copy button needs aria-describedby referencing 'save-warning' that reads: 'This key will be revealed once; store it now.' Also ensure reveal requires a confirm for stale sessions.
mai: UI nit: in the empty state show three example scope presets (Read-only, Deploy, Full) as quick-choose buttons to reduce cognitive load.
harry: and add a small helper text: 'Least privilege recommended' with info icon linking to docs.
infra-bot: reminder: feature-flag keys_preview_card rolling to staging 2026-04-10. include a11y review.
mai: thanks, I'll update the figma and file acceptance criteria. :thumbsup:
